channel.title: Latest Official Public alerts in English for Bureau of Meteorology
channel.description: This feed lists the most recent Official Public alerts in English for Bureau of Meteorology

item.title: Warning to Sheep Graziers for Northern Tablelands forecast district
item.description: Sheep graziers are warned that cold temperatures, showers and easterly winds are expected during Saturday. Areas likely to be affected include parts of the Northern Tablelands forecast district. There is a risk of losses of lambs and sheep exposed to these conditions.

item.title: Cancellation of Severe Thunderstorm Warning for North West Pastoral forecast district
Severe Thunderstorm Warning for North West Pastoral forecast district
item.description: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Marla, Ernabella and parts of the Great Victoria Desert.
